body:
Dear colleagues,

Following approval by the Management Committee, please note the updated training budget policy (v3.0), effective 2025-01-01.

Each employee has a training budget of EUR 1,500 per calendar year. Unused budget does not roll over. Requests are approved through the learning portal.

The full policy is available on the HR SharePoint (HR Policies > Current Policies). This replaces all previous versions.

Kind regards,
Wim Goossens
Head of HR
Vandenberg Logistics NV
